prompt:
Freehand East Asian ink painting in the spontaneous, expressive manner (xieyi, sumi-e) on warm off-white rice paper: black ink diluted into a few grey tones, brushed quickly with a large soft brush. The whole painting is made of only about forty brush strokes. Every object is reduced to one to five strokes: the cottage is one dark wash for the roof, two pale strokes for the walls and one dark accent for the chimney; each boat is one curved dark stroke for the hull and one thin stroke for the mast; the jetty is a few dark vertical dabs for the posts and one pale horizontal stroke; the lighthouse is two vertical strokes and a small dark cap; the headland is one large wet splash of ink that bleeds into the paper at its edges and fades into mist below; the barrels and crates are a few small dark blots; the lantern post is one thin vertical stroke. Strokes swell and taper and break into dry-brush streaks with flecks of white paper; wet washes bleed with soft feathered edges. At least two thirds of the sheet is untouched blank paper: sky, water and mist are empty paper. Strong contrast between a few very dark accents and pale washes. No textures at all: no individual stones, no planks, no roof tiles, no window frames, no rigging, no rocks drawn one by one, no fine lines. Black ink only; the single exception in the whole painting is the one red band of the lighthouse, a flat wash of vermilion. Not a detailed ink-and-wash illustration, not a pen drawing, not a photograph, not a 3D render, not a digital painting, not a woodblock print, not a postcard, no orange or yellow anywhere, no seal stamps, no calligraphy, no frame or border.

Composition for a wide game screen (the picture will be cropped by about one tenth at the top and at the bottom), eye-level side view across the harbour, the horizon a little below the middle of the picture. The cottage stands at the left edge, its chimney top at about one third from the top of the picture. The lighthouse on its rocky headland stands at about four fifths of the width, its top at about one quarter from the top. The short jetty with the two small boats lies in the middle distance in the left half. The iron lantern on its wooden post stands at the back edge of the quay a little right of the middle. The whole upper middle of the picture between the cottage and the lighthouse is empty sky, bare paper with at most a very pale wash, because text will be written there later. The lower fifth of the picture is the quay in the foreground, suggested only by a few long horizontal dry-brush strokes along its front and back edges and otherwise bare paper, where characters will walk; the barrels, the crates and the rope stand at the back edge of the quay next to the water, not on this strip. Towards all four edges the ink fades out into bare paper.

Location: the small harbour of Lornholm, a fictional island in a northern sea, at dusk. A stone quay with a short wooden jetty runs along the lower third of the picture. Two small wooden fishing boats are moored at the jetty. On a rocky headland on the right stands a white lighthouse with one red band, its lamp lit. On the left a small stone harbour-master's cottage with a lit window and a smoking chimney. On the quay: two barrels, a stack of crates, a coil of rope and an iron lantern on a wooden post. Calm sea, low clouds, a band of orange light at the horizon, the first stars.

Important for the game version: some things move in the game and are added later as separate animated layers, so paint them exactly as described here, even where the description above says otherwise. No smoke at all above the chimney: the chimney top stands clean against the empty paper. The lighthouse lamp only as a small spot of bare paper inside the dark lantern room, without any beam, rays or halo. The lit window and the lantern only as small spots of bare paper. The band of light at the horizon is a strip of bare paper, not orange; above it the sky is bare paper with a very pale grey wash that becomes slightly darker towards the top, with only one or two pale horizontal wash streaks near the horizon as clouds; no stars, no moon. The water is bare paper with only a few short horizontal dry-brush strokes and pale reflections of the boats. Pale mist lies over the far water and around the foot of the headland. No birds.

Leave the quay in the foreground free of characters: it is a game background, characters are added later as separate sprites.

No text, letters, numbers, signatures, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image. No real places, brands, franchises or recognisable characters from existing games or films.

Image format: landscape 3:2.
